question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

Rumour mongering is __one of the bad habit__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'One of the bad habits'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate option** that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is 3) one of the bad habits.
 
• The **original sentence states** "Rumour mongering is one of the bad habit."
 
• However,** "habit" **is a countable noun, so it should be pluralized when used in the context of "one of."
 
• Therefore, the **correct substitution **should be "one of the bad habits" to maintain grammatical correctness.(बुरी आदतों में से एक)

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is:* Rumour mongering is **one of the bad habits***​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1)** "ones of the worse habit" **is incorrect because it uses the wrong form of "one" and "habit," and it should be "worse habits" instead of "worse habit."
 
• Option 4) **"one of the worse habit"** is incorrect because it uses the wrong form of "worse" and "habit," and it should be "worse habits" instead of "worse habit."
